frequency_question: How often do authorities successfully deliver an inflation rate above 5.0 percent when targeting or tolerating higher bands within emerging market central banking frameworks?
membership_rule: Emerging market central banks with flexible inflation targeting frameworks operating under distinct mandates to manage price stability over a rolling multi-year horizon.

cases.name: RBI flexible inflation targeting target adherence 2019-2020

coverage_note: 5 named cycles representing major policy epochs since the inception of the flexible inflation targeting framework in India.
known_gaps: Excludes minor quarterly oscillations that did not involve explicit structural policy posture shifts.
skeleton: Five distinct monetary policy review cycles under the current inflation-targeting framework where baseline price pressures tested the upper tolerance threshold.
multiplier: 5 cycles examined, 3 resulting in headline inflation printing above 5 percent.
validity_reason: The monetary policy framework and institutional mandate remain stable through this horizon.
